text:
marie: FYI — Customer Atlas wants EU-only dataflow for a 3-week POC starting mid-April. They're asking for: 1) explicit list of EU subprocessors, 2) ability to pin tenant to EU with deterministic routing/fallback behavior, 3) pricing delta for geo-pin + reserved capacity, 4) BYOK feasibility.

samira: Ack. Looping in @josh (infra) and @legal-ops. Quick Q: do we have a short answer on hard pin vs geo-affinity for Hosted vs Dedicated?

josh: Short answer: Dedicated and Private -> yes, hard tenant pinning. Hosted -> we provide geo-affinity (preferred region) but not hard pinning w/o dedicated resources. Fallback behavior can be configured:
- reject requests when EU capacity exhausted
- route to a pre-approved EU-compatible fallback region (eu-central-1)
- route to hosted fallback with customer consent (explicit opt-in)

josh: example routing config they can expect:
```json
{
  "tenant_routing": {"primary": "eu-west-1", "failover": "eu-central-1", "policy": "reject_on_capacity_exhausted"},
  "kms": "customer-managed (BYOK optional)",
  "kv_cache": "no cross-region replication"
}
```

legal-ops: We'll need subprocessor attestation for all EU subprocessors + signed DPA. For BYOK: require key material residency in EU and a key policy that prevents export. Also confirm any cross-border logs (audit traces) are redacted or stored in EU.

infra-bot: Capacity probe result: eu-west-1 (requested GPU SKU) -> 12 GPUs free window week-of-2026-04-12, 90% utilization next 30 days. Recommend reserved pool or dedicated node allocation for POC.

samira: Pricing thumb-rule: geo-pin + reserved capacity -> estimate +40-60% over hosted per-token price for the committed months. BYOK integration ~ $5k one-time + ~ $300/mo key ops (rough). I'll get exact quote from pricing.

marie: Also customer wants the current list of EU subprocessors + SOC2 cert copy. Samira, can you attach and confirm we'll have attestation before kickoff?

samira: On it. I'll pull subproc list and SOC2 PDF from the repo and confirm timelines. Planning a call with customer Wed 15:00 CET to walk through options. Anything else to surface before the call?

josh: Please surface: capacity commit options (min GPUs), expected latency difference if failover to eu-central, and the one-time BYOK integration lead time (2-3 business days for Dedicated).

marie: Great. I'll add those bullets to the presales checklist and share the calendar invite. :thumbsup:
